name: CI

on:
    push:
        branches: [main]
    pull_request:

permissions:
    contents: read

concurrency:
    group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
    cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
    check:
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        env:
            DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER: "1"
            CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC: "1"
        steps:
            - uses: actions/checkout@v4

            - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
              with:
                  bun-version-file: package.json

            - name: Install dependencies
              run: bun install --frozen-lockfile

            - name: Typecheck
              run: bun run typecheck

            - name: Lint and format check
              run: bun run lint

            - name: Test
              run: bun run test

            # The committed engine types name the Claude Code version that wrote
            # them on their first line; install that one so the mod is tested
            # and validated against the same plugin API it is type-checked against.
            - name: Install Claude Code
              run: |
                  version=$(head -n 1 .claude-plugin/types/claude-code/index.d.ts | sed -n 's/^\/\/ Written by Claude Code \([0-9][^ ]*\)\.$/\1/p')
                  if [ -z "$version" ]; then
                      echo "::error file=.claude-plugin/types/claude-code/index.d.ts::cannot read the Claude Code version from the first line"
                      exit 1
                  fi
                  npm install --global "@anthropic-ai/claude-code@$version"
                  claude --version

            - name: Test the hooks module against the engine
              run: bun run test:mod

            - name: Validate the plugin
              run: bun run validate

input.recap: CI run 41683687126 passed but has two notices: actions/checkout@v4 still targets the deprecated Node 20, and ubuntu-latest is moving to Ubuntu 26. Nothing has been changed yet.
input.ask: Bump actions/checkout to v7 in ci.yml?

content.text:
The run ([run 41683687126](https://github.com/jessearmand/claude-decisions-mod/actions/runs/41683687126), job `check`) passed, but it has two annotations. Only one of them needs a change.

**1. Node.js 20 is deprecated (warning). Needs a fix.**
> "actions target Node.js 20 but are being forced to run on Node.js 24: actions/checkout@v4"

- **Cause:** `actions/checkout@v4` at [.github/workflows/ci.yml](.github/workflows/ci.yml) still declares `using: node20`. The runner is currently forcing it onto Node 24. Once Node 20 is removed from runners, that override stops and this becomes a failure, not just a warning.
- **Fix:** bump to a version that declares `node24`. v5, v6 and v7 all do; the latest is v7.0.1.
  - v6 changed how credentials are stored: they now go in a separate file, not `.git/config`. This workflow never reuses git credentials, so it isn't affected.
  - v7 switched to ESM and now refuses to check out fork PRs under `pull_request_target` and `workflow_run`. This workflow uses neither trigger, so it isn't affected either.
  - **Recommendation:** go straight to `@v7`.
- `oven-sh/setup-bun@v2` is already on `node24`, so it needs no change.

**2. ubuntu-latest moves to Ubuntu 26 (notice). No action needed.**
> "The ubuntu-latest label will migrate to Ubuntu 26 beginning October 19, 2026"

This is informational. The migration began on Oct 19, so some runs may already be on Ubuntu 26. The job only needs Bun, npm and the `claude` CLI, so the new image is unlikely to break anything. If you'd rather choose when to move, pin `runs-on: ubuntu-24.04` and upgrade on purpose later. I'd leave it as `ubuntu-latest`.

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
- The Node version comes from the action's own `action.yml` (`runs.using`), not from your workflow. That's why the only fix is a new major tag, and why `setup-bun@v2` is already fine without a bump.
- Floating major tags like `@v2` pick up runtime bumps automatically within that major. Moving from Node 20 to 24 counted as a breaking change for checkout, though, so it only arrived in v5 and you have to bump the tag yourself.
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`
